audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Yone/Yone/Skill/Skill/Yone/Skill/Yone against the content win[N] and packet chart of Skill/Skill/Yone/Skill/Ekko/Yone/Ekko — the level 6 and first-item rows were exactly inverted.
audit.why: Level 6 is Ekko's (Chronobreak plus the W stun answers the Fate Sealed skirmish); the first-item row is Yone's, which is what the content spike text already argues.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to the content/packet chart, ratings and whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s against Chronobreak's 110/80/50, so your ult returns faster at every rank — the level 6 and first-item rows now say so with numbers.
audit.corrected: Cooldown pairing stated in breakdown.cooldowns and phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Spirit Cleave shields him on a flat 14s cooldown, and the late-game text claimed Yone dives 'from stealth'.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave grants a shield scaling with champions hit; Soul Unbound leaves his body behind, it is not stealth.
audit.corrected: Shield added to two fields; the stealth claim replaced with Soul Unbound.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits, and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — fifteen seconds is a magnitude with no source.
audit.corrected: Real numbers used for Soul Unbound, Spirit Cleave, Fate Sealed and Chronobreak.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.corrected: Rewritten to their titles: Parallel Convergence's 1600-range pre-placement, and Q1 stacking off minions inside his wave.

edits.after: His level 3: the Q2 dash plus Soul Unbound turns any still target into a full all-in — keep moving.

edits.after: Ekko

edits.before: Chronobreak online — your aggression gets a save file. Trade like the rewind exists, because it does.
edits.after: Chronobreak online — your W stun plus the rewind covers the skirmish his Fate Sealed opens up.

edits.after: Yone

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It governs your forward steps. - R Chronobreak spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5 — survive the spirit and punish the body it snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave: 14s, and it shields him. - Fate Sealed: 120s at rank 1 against your 110s Chronobreak.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Three hits proc the passive and hand you the speed to leave — Spirit Cleave shields the first, so land all three.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Parallel Convergence casts from 1600 and arms on a delay — drop it on his retreat line before you start the trade, not during it.

edits.before: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — that is a 22-second invitation.

edits.before: That’s Yone’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is a 4s cooldown — he wins any swing past your third hit.

edits.before: The rewind heals off the hologram's path — diving away from your own past is how Ekkos die with R up.
edits.after: Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 — without it a Q3 knockup into Fate Sealed just kills you outright.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: His wave is Q1 stacks — every minion he hits arms the knockup, so trading in it hands him the combo free.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Yone wins by stacking Mortal Steel off minions, knocking you up with Q3, and cashing it into Fate Sealed from 1000 range.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry by never standing still — his Q3 knockup needs a static target, and Phase Dive at 9s is how you deny it.

edits.before: With your first burst item online you out-trade him in a straight fight and W-R gives you a reliable pick tool with Chronobreak as a safety net, but Yone remains dangerous split-pushing or diving from stealth, so group for objectives and force fights where your team can peel or follow up his engage.
edits.after: With your first burst item online you out-trade him in a straight fight and W-R gives you a reliable pick tool with Chronobreak as a safety net, but Yone remains dangerous split-pushing or diving out of Soul Unbound, so group for objectives and force fights where your team can peel his engage.
